name: lumberroom-memory
description: lumberroom as Claude Code's memory: the digest in the system prompt, a periodic search-and-write reminder, optional per-prompt recall, built-in memory off.

project.title: Project
project.description: auto takes the git root's folder name as the project slug; none sends no project; anything else is the slug itself.

recall.title: Recall per prompt
recall.description: Search lumberroom with each prompt and attach new hits for the model. Off by default: each block stays in context for the rest of the session and costs input tokens on every later turn, and weak matches fill the context.

recallExtraProjects.title: Extra recall projects
recallExtraProjects.description: Other project slugs to search with each prompt. A bare slug applies everywhere; project=slug1+slug2 applies only in that project, for example lumberroom-cloud=lumberroom.

recallMaxChars.title: Recall block cap
recallMaxChars.description: Characters the whole recall block may add (tags, note, hits and write reminder). Each block stays in context for the rest of the session.

recallMinSimilarity.title: Recall similarity floor
recallMinSimilarity.description: Drop hits whose similarity is below this, from 0 to 1. Hits that carry no similarity pass. Prompts under 12 characters skip recall.

recallTimeoutMs.title: Recall timeout (ms)
recallTimeoutMs.description: How long a prompt waits for memory_search before going on without it.

bootstrapTimeoutMs.title: Bootstrap timeout (ms)
bootstrapTimeoutMs.description: How long session start waits for context_bootstrap.

digestMaxChars.title: Digest cap
digestMaxChars.description: Characters the digest section of the system prompt may hold.

reviewInterval.title: Reminder interval
reviewInterval.description: Remind the model to search lumberroom before assuming and to write durable facts after the exchange, every N prompts from you, with recall on or off. 0 turns it off.

replaceBuiltinMemory.title: Replace built-in memory
replaceBuiltinMemory.description: Drop Claude Code's own memory section and refuse file tools on its memory files.

extractor.title: Extractor
extractor.description: One of off, turn or session-end. off writes nothing on its own. turn extracts every N turns, session-end once as the session ends; both call memory_write directly. Any other value reads as off.

extractorModel.title: Extractor model
extractorModel.description: Model alias the extractor runs on.

ingestToken.title: Ingest token
ingestToken.description: Optional. /lr-import uses the lumberroom CLI's login when this is empty. A bearer with mayIngest overrides it. Kept in secure storage.
